about: Regnal numbers after a monarch's or pope's name read as ordinals in map names (BI-023, the English half of CROSS X-017/X-018): 'King George VI Ave' is 'King George the sixth Avenue', 'Pope John Paul II Blvd' 'Pope John Paul the second Boulevard'. Only after a known regnal given name, or any capitalised name after a title (King, Pope, Sultan...); I..XXXIX only. Negatives: World War II, Phase II, Malcolm X, middle initials ('John V. Smith'), the pronoun ('Henry I think'), malformed numerals. Backseat Driver: backseat::pronunciation::ForSpeech / Regnal (libs/backseat/backseat_tests/pronunciation_test.cpp). Port to BookLyre's English text pass with the same cases.
